sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): scampering forward, the blowgun held level in both hands, pointing forward, the backpack bouncing on his back, the LEGS CHANGING OVER as written for each frame
sheets.weapons: THE BLOWGUN AND THE BACKPACK go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the long blowgun, as long as in image 1 - held level, raised to his mouth or tipped up as the pale figure holds it (on the ground beside him when he dies); the rolled backpack stays on his back. In R the small green mushroom is in his hand where the pale figure holds it. The green hat with its goggles and blue feather stays on his head. Only him: no darts, no poison, no smoke, no glow.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) straight down under his hips, his green boot flat on the ground line; the FAR leg (the darker one) bent and kicked back behind him, its foot off the ground. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must show a different leg planted. Draw the legs AS WRITTEN for each frame, not the pale figure's (the old 1x legs are too small to read; runs drawn after them kept the same legs in all 8 frames: 「走路没有换腿」). The body, the head, the hat, the blowgun and the backpack follow the pale figure. The blowgun is NOT a leg: his two short legs carry him.
